recipes.name: Chocolate Fudge Brownie Bites
instructions: In a food processor, combine the dates, walnuts, cashews, cocoa powder, and salt. Blend until combined, being careful not to over-process, as this can result in an oily texture.
Add the chocolate and pulse a few times, until coarsely chopped and incorporated.
Using your hands, form the mixture into balls. If desired, roll in a decorative coating. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If hard, soak the dates in warm water for 10 minutes and drain. † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Store in the freezer for up to 2 months.
